title: Seeding Bacterial Cultures in Microfluidic Chambers
author: Francisco Javier Quero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9g9h3z6

steps.title: Prepare Initial Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Streak cells from stock onto an LB agar plate and incubate overnight at 37 ºC.

steps.title: Inoculate LB Broth
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony from the plate and inoculate it into 3 ml of LB broth in a 50 ml conical tube.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the culture at 37 ºC in a shaker.

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: After 2.5 h of incubation, centrifuge the cell culture at a relative centrifugal force of 2,100 for 1 min.

steps.title: Load Cells into Microfluidics
steps.instruction: Re-suspend the cell pellet in MSgg and immediately load the suspension into the microfluidic chambers.

steps.title: Incubate Cells in Chambers
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells in the microfluidic chamber at 37 ºC for 90 min, then maintain the temperature at 30 ºC for the remainder of the experiment.
